name: Chayle Run 2027 Season 2
short_description: Chayle Run 2027 Season 2 is a 21 km half marathon, 10 km and 5 km on Sunday 14 February 2027, starting at 5am from the Samut Sakhon Aquarium.
ai_summary: Chayle Run 2027 Season 2 is the second edition of a road race in Samut Sakhon, south-west of Bangkok, on Sunday 14 February 2027. The 21 km half marathon starts at 5am from the Samut Sakhon Aquarium, followed by the 10 km at 5.30am and the 5 km at 5.45am, and the half has a four-hour cut-off. It is organised and timed by RecRace Sport, with entries from THB 500 to 800.

faqs.question: When is Chayle Run 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 14 February 2027. The 21 km half marathon starts at 5am, the 10 km at 5.30am and the 5 km at 5.45am, all from the Samut Sakhon Aquarium. Race kits are collected at the aquarium on Saturday 13 February from 1pm to 6pm, and a postal delivery option is offered until 31 December 2026.

faqs.question: How much does Chayle Run 2027 cost?
faqs.answer: Early-bird fees, from 23 October to 10 November 2026, are THB 700 for the 21 km, THB 600 for the 10 km and THB 500 for the 5 km. Standard fees from 11 November to 31 December 2026 are THB 800, 700 and 600. The 21 km and 10 km are chip-timed.

faqs.question: What are the cut-offs at Chayle Run?
faqs.answer: The half marathon has a four-hour cut-off, and only 21 km finishers inside it receive the finisher shirt. The entry page gives the 10 km cut-off as 2 hours 30 minutes in Thai but 3 hours in English, so plan for the shorter one. Trophies go to the overall winners and five deep in each age group.
